description: Rate of change of an entity's sentiment (the smoothed derivative of its rolling sentiment) over 7d or 30d, an early reversal signal. Unseeded until the window holds two daily sentiment samples. Pro tier. meta.status is unseeded when there is no measurement yet (data.value is then a placeholder), partial when some inputs were defaulted (meta.diagnostic.missing) and stale when the newest value is over 48 hours old. An unknown entity is an error (HTTP 404).
name: get_sentiment_velocity
